text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, such as sorting emails or entering data, which saves time. Productivity tools powered by AI can also help employees organise their schedules and make faster decisions. However, AI does not replace people completely. Instead, human-AI collaboration is becoming more common, where workers use AI to support their skills rather than lose them. This means some jobs are changing, and new roles are appearing. Employees may need training to work alongside these tools. Overall, AI can make workplaces more efficient, but people remain essential for creativity, judgement, and communication.
